"""Live controller for the VLABench select_poker instance.

Uses only the RCB client observations and joint position commands.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot


def connect() -> Robot:
    return Robot()


def hold(robot: Robot, joints: np.ndarray, seconds: float, *, cameras=None, video="none"):
    """Hold one 9D Panda actuator target for the requested duration."""
    dt = float(robot.spec().get("control_dt", 0.1))
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / dt)))
    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(np.asarray(joints, dtype=float)[None, :], n, axis=0),
                        dt=dt, interpolate="hold", cameras=cameras, video=video)


def main() -> None:
    robot = connect()
    print("spec", robot.spec())
    print("status", robot.status())
    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
    for name, frame in obs.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(f"/app/output/initial_{name}.png")
    print("saved initial camera frames")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Live controller for VLABench select_poker, using only RCB observations.

The controller uses finite-difference TCP position Jacobians and damped least
squares in joint space. Commands and observations are recorded by the service.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.1
ARM_LIMITS = np.array([[-2.8973, 2.8973], [-1.7628, 1.7628], [-2.8973, 2.8973],
                       [-3.0718, -0.0698], [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-0.0175, 3.7525],
                       [-2.8973, 2.8973]])


def connect() -> Robot:
    return Robot()


def observe(robot: Robot, camera: str = "wrist"):
    return robot.get_obs(cameras=[camera], video="none")


def proprio(robot: Robot, camera: str = "wrist") -> np.ndarray:
    return np.asarray(observe(robot, camera).meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)


def targets(robot: Robot, seconds: float, joints: np.ndarray, *, camera=None, video="none"):
    """Hold one absolute nine actuator target for the requested duration."""
    dt = float(robot.spec().get("control_dt", DT))
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / dt)))
    q = np.asarray(joints, dtype=float).reshape(9)
    result = None
    for start in range(0, n, max(1, int(round(10.0 / dt)))):
        count = min(max(1, int(round(10.0 / dt))), n - start)
        result = robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(q[None, :], count, axis=0),
                              dt=dt, interpolate="hold", cameras=camera, video=video)
        if result.done:
            break
    return result


def current(robot: Robot, camera: str = "wrist"):
    p = proprio(robot, camera)
    return p[:7].copy(), p[17:20].copy(), p[20:24].copy(), p[30:32].copy()


def jacobian_xyz(robot: Robot, *, probe=0.08, dwell=0.5, camera="wrist") -> np.ndarray:
    """Estimate d(TCP xyz)/d(joints) in-place, returning to the starting target."""
    q0, x0, _, fingers = current(robot, camera)
    cmd = np.r_[q0, fingers]
    J = np.zeros((3, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        qtest = q0.copy()
        qtest[j] = np.clip(qtest[j] + probe, ARM_LIMITS[j, 0] + 0.02, ARM_LIMITS[j, 1] - 0.02)
        actual_delta = qtest[j] - q0[j]
        if abs(actual_delta) < 1e-5:
            qtest[j] = q0[j] - probe
            actual_delta = qtest[j] - q0[j]
        targets(robot, dwell, np.r_[qtest, fingers])
        q1, x1, _, _ = current(robot, camera)
        dq = q1 - q0
        if abs(dq[j]) > 0.003:
            J[:, j] = (x1 - x0) / dq[j]
        # Return to the local base pose before probing another axis.
        targets(robot, dwell, cmd)
    return J


def dls_step(J: np.ndarray, delta_xyz: np.ndarray, damping=0.06) -> np.ndarray:
    """Minimum-norm damped least-squares joint increment for a Cartesian step."""
    return J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + damping * damping * np.eye(3), delta_xyz)


def main() -> None:
    robot = connect()
    print("spec", robot.spec())
    print("status", robot.status())
    print("proprio", proprio(robot))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
